rules: Nine of the ten counted tables are printed as several side-by-side blocks of the same two or four columns, so `cols` counts the physical grid and `rows` the deepest block: Table 2 is four blocks of two columns, Tables 11 and 12 five blocks [table.cols] [table.rows].

Two rule styles split the paper. Tables 2, 3, 6, 9, 11 and 12 sit in a closed box with vertical rules between every column and no rules between body rows; Tables 1, 5, 7 and 10 are open-sided with three horizontal rules only [table.rule_style].
Three of the thirteen printed tables are bare text columns with no rules drawn and no measured region: Table 4 on p11, Table 8 at the head of p15 and Table 13 on p19 [table.rows].

Table 1 is the only table no sentence cites; Tables 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11 and 12 are each named once and Tables 6, 7, 8 and 13 more than once, Table 13 from a page four before the appendix prints it [mention.lead_sentence] [mention.count].

Every caption in the paper is the numbered form with a colon, `Table N:` or `Figure N:`, and every caption prints below its exhibit; captions run from three words to a full sentence and only Table 8 states a condition [caption.position] [caption.numbering].

Three regions on p6, p7 and p8 are typeset Algorithm boxes, not exhibits, and are excluded `not-an-exhibit`; a pseudocode listing has no drawing, so no geometry rule can catch it and only the header bar has ink [place.area_frac].

Figure 1 is a node-link hairball with 83 labelled nodes and no axes, so it carries printed_numbers false and data_labels true; its colour key lives in the citing sentence rather than in a legend [geometry.printed_numbers] [geometry.legend].
Every heading in the paper is numbered, so `section_path` is a numbered chain and section_numbered is true throughout [place.section_numbered].
